cards.name: vehicle-log-monthly-filter
cards.description: Use date range filters for monthly vehicle log queries instead of listing individual days.
cards.claim: When asked for totals over a month, use `date >= 'YYYY-MM-01' AND date < 'YYYY-(MM+1)-01'` to avoid truncation or missing days.

cards.name: attendance-absence-interpretation
cards.description: The column 'A' in staff attendance represents the count of absent days.
cards.claim: Column 'A' contains the total number of absent days for each staff member; sort by this column descending to find those with most absences.
